name: markerObject
signature: markerObject(QString objectName, bool visible, QString mtype, QString color, float size, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs)
description: Creates a visual marker attached to a celestial object (star, planet, galaxy, etc.). The marker follows the object as it moves across the sky. Useful for highlighting specific objects in presentations or educational content.

parameters.name: objectName
parameters.description: English name of the celestial object to attach the marker to (e.g., 'Mars', 'Sirius', 'Andromeda Galaxy')

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the marker starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: mtype
parameters.description: Marker shape type: 'cross', 'circle', 'ellipse', 'square', 'dotted-circle', 'circled-cross' (or 'circled-plus'), 'dashed-square', 'squared-dotted-circle' (or 'squared-dcircle'), 'crossed-circle', 'target', 'gear', 'disk'

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: HTML-like color specification (e.g., '#ffff00' for yellow, '#ff6666' for light red)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Marker size in pixels

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, the marker is automatically deleted after being displayed once

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: If non-zero, automatically deletes the marker after this many milliseconds

returnDescription: Unique marker ID (returns -1 if object not found)

compatibility.notes: Introduced in Stellarium 0.19.0, works on all later versions

name: markerEquatorial
signature: markerEquatorial(QString RA, QString Dec, bool j2000epoch, bool visible, QString mtype, QString color, float size, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs, bool withAberration)
description: Creates a visual marker fixed to a specific Equatorial coordinate (Right Ascension/Declination). The marker stays at that celestial position, useful for marking deep-sky object positions, exoplanet host stars, or other points of interest.

parameters.name: RA
parameters.description: Right Ascension (e.g., '5h10m31s' or '82.5°')

parameters.name: Dec
parameters.description: Declination (e.g., '25d30m30s' or '-45°')

parameters.name: j2000epoch
parameters.description: If true, coordinates are treated as J2000.0 epoch; if false, as current date coordinates (converted to J2000 at creation time)

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the marker starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: mtype
parameters.description: Marker shape type: 'cross', 'circle', 'ellipse', 'square', 'dotted-circle', 'circled-cross', 'dashed-square', 'squared-dotted-circle', 'crossed-circle', 'target', 'gear', 'disk'

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: HTML-like color specification (e.g., '#ffaa88')

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Marker size in pixels

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, automatically deleted after being displayed once

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Auto-delete timeout in milliseconds

parameters.name: withAberration
parameters.description: If true, coordinates are subject to aberration correction; if false, they represent strict frame coordinates

returnDescription: Unique marker ID (returns -1 if creation failed)

name: markerHorizon
signature: markerHorizon(QString az, QString alt, bool visible, QString mtype, QString color, float size, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs)
description: Creates a visual marker fixed to a specific Altitude/Azimuth (horizontal) coordinate. The marker stays at that compass direction and altitude as the sky rotates, useful for marking landscape features, cardinal directions, or telescope pointing targets.

parameters.name: az
parameters.description: Azimuth angle (e.g., '0°' for North, '90°' for East, '180°' for South, '270°' for West)

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Altitude angle in degrees (0° = horizon, 90° = zenith)

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the marker starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: mtype
parameters.description: Marker shape type: 'cross', 'circle', 'ellipse', 'square', 'dotted-circle', 'circled-cross', 'dashed-square', 'squared-dotted-circle', 'crossed-circle', 'target', 'gear', 'disk'

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: HTML-like color specification (e.g., '#ffaa00' for orange)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Marker size in pixels

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, automatically deleted after being displayed once

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Auto-delete timeout in milliseconds

returnDescription: Unique marker ID (returns -1 if creation failed)

name: getMarkerShow
description: Returns whether a marker is currently visible (shown) or hidden.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique marker ID returned by one of the marker creation functions

returnDescription: true if the marker is visible, false if hidden or marker does not exist

name: setMarkerShow
description: Shows or hides an existing marker by its ID. The marker fades in/out smoothly based on its fade duration settings.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique marker ID returned by one of the marker creation functions

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show the marker, false to hide it

name: deleteMarker
description: Permanently deletes a marker by its ID. The marker is removed from memory and will no longer be displayed. Useful for cleaning up markers that are no longer needed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique marker ID returned by one of the marker creation functions

name: deleteAllMarkers
description: Deletes all custom markers created by the script. Returns the number of markers that were deleted. Useful for cleaning up at the end of a presentation or script.
